sentence_stem: Yesterday I forgot my keys, so
correct_completion: I had to wait outside the house for an hour.
full_sentence: Yesterday I forgot my keys, so I had to wait outside the house for an hour.
acceptable_variants: I called my brother to open the door.

options.text: I wrote a long letter to my aunt.
options.why_wrong: This is an unrelated action. It does not show a result of forgetting the keys.

options.text: I went to bed early and slept well.
options.why_wrong: This does not follow from forgetting the keys. The connector 'so' needs a result of the first clause.

options.text: I had to wait outside the house for an hour.
I bought a new pair of shoes.
options.why_wrong: This is a separate purchase with no link to the missing keys, so it does not complete the cause and effect.

grammar_focus: Past simple with 'so' to show a result
explanation: After 'so', we need a clause that states the result of the first clause. Here the result of forgetting the keys is waiting outside the house, using the past simple form of 'have'.
translation: Вчора я забув ключі, тому мені довелося годину чекати біля будинку.
